content.text: Liga MX Betting Preview: Santos Laguna vs AméricaSantos Laguna clash with América at Estadio Nuevo Corona, with kick-off set for 22:00 on Saturday 4 April.Santos to Give América a Tough TestSantos Laguna +1 on the Asian Handicap could be the order of the day. We can back them at -114 against América and benefit if the underdogs draw or win, while there’s stake back if they only lose by a single goal.América Won 3-0 in Teams’ Last EncounterSantos Laguna were winners last time out. It was a 2-1 home win against Club Puebla at Estadio Nuevo Corona. Omar Tapia's men enjoyed 47% possession and had nine shots on target, while Ezequiel Bullaude and Aldo Lopez scored one goal apiece.Club América were defeated in their previous game. On their travels, they suffered a 1-0 loss against Pumas UNAM at Olimpico Universitario. Las Águilas boasted 57% possession and had four shots on goal.Head-to-Head StatisticsAmérica have landed three straight victories over Santos. In the last clash, América secured a 3-0 win when hosting at Estadio de la Ciudad de los Deportes. The previous 10 H2H games have featured six América victories and four draws.
